sources.entry: agents-md-cookbook by Taiizor - The tested, tool-agnostic AGENTS.md kit — verified templates, a CI linter, and migrators from .cursorrules/CLAUDE.md/Copilot/Windsurf/Cline/Aider.

summary.one_liner: A cookbook of tested, tool-agnostic AGENTS.md templates for many stacks, plus a CI linter and migration tool for moving old CLAUDE.md or .cursorrules files to AGENTS.md.
summary.what_it_does: Provides copy-paste AGENTS.md templates for 16 stacks (TypeScript/Node, Python, Go, Rust, Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Next.js, React+Vite, Django, FastAPI, Rails, monorepo, data/ML, React Native, minimal, and a Tuurio OIDC variant). Each template is meant to be short (60-150 lines), lead with runnable commands, and be checked by the repo's own linter. The README describes two npm CLIs: agents-md-lint, which scores a file against its rules and can fail CI, and agents-md-migrate, which converts CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or GEMINI.md into a single AGENTS.md. It also includes a compatibility matrix listing which tools read AGENTS.md natively, via adapter, or via config. The README notes that the CLIs live under packages/ and are released separately. Background research cited in the README covers GitHub's 2,500-repo study, ETH Zurich's AGENTbench, and Augment's golden-PR eval.
use_cases: Start a new AGENTS.md for a specific stack
Lint agent instruction files in CI
Check which coding agents read AGENTS.md
Keep agent instructions short and command-first
Set up AGENTS.md for a monorepo
how_to_run: curl -fsSL <template URL> -o AGENTS.md  (copy a template for your stack into repo root; exact URL elided in the README)
bunx agents-md-lint AGENTS.md  (or: npx agents-md-lint AGENTS.md), run in CI
Optional: use the bundled action via uses: Taiizor/agents-md-cookbook@v1 with path: AGENTS.md
notable: Tool compatibility matrix covering Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Zed, Jules, Amp, Claude Code, Aider, and Gemini CLI
Migrator that converts CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, and GEMINI.md into one AGENTS.md
Templates are linted by the repo's own agents-md-lint in CI
Bundled GitHub Action for linting AGENTS.md
caveats: The agents-md-lint and agents-md-migrate CLIs live under packages/ and are released by separate plans, so availability may vary
The README's quick-start curl URL is elided in the provided text, so exact template download paths are not shown here
Compatibility status for tools changes over time; the README points to COMPATIBILITY.md with a last-verified date
